fn: Map (Plan, Section, 3D): new Collars only chip next to Hide other holes: shows just the collar of each hole, without the hole paths or depth labels. New Slice along hole chip: select a hole, then tap it. Plan turns the map so the hole runs up the screen, Section slices along the hole (width +/-1 m), 3D shows a thin slice along the hole. Tap again to look from the other side; Reset north goes back.
ds: Plan map: new Collars only option (same as FN).
